notes:
**Manuscript v0.8.11 highlights:**

- Citing under the Note appearance now creates the footnote for you
- Bibliography sections
- Endnotes
- Page numbers for citations inside footnotes
- A caution when a heading style matches ordinary body text
- Chicago, Turabian, MHRA and OSCOLA note styles are now bundled
- Archival and non-journal sources in Add Reference
- Citations can now read as short note forms in the editor
- Citations inside imported footnotes link to your references
- Per-chapter footnote numbering
- Short titles for repeat citations
- Word-limit scope: body only, or notes and bibliography too
- Zotero and Mendeley citations import as live citations
- The local check script now says when your pandoc is not the one CI uses
- A misconfigured AI endpoint can no longer flood memory
- APA and other author–date in-text citations
- Undo removes an auto-created citation footnote in one step
- Bibliography order under author–date and note styles
- Bibliography entries no longer fuse fields together
- Contributor labels in citations
- Word export no longer slows to a crawl on a heavily footnoted thesis
- Reopening a manuscript you exported keeps its title, and stops stacking title pages
- Exponents, unit powers and labelled numbers are no longer mistaken for citations
- Titles with angle brackets, moved footnote markers, and note linking without a bibliography
- Editing near footnote markers in a large note-styled thesis is much quicker
- Sections with many in-text citations
- Divided bibliography reported out of date
- All citation locator types now render their label
- Merging duplicate references now re-points citations inside footnotes
- Note citation chips update when a reference is edited
- Chicago, Turabian and MHRA notes no longer drop the author after the first citation
- Linking imported note-form citations scales with a large library
- A page number typed after a note citation no longer doubles the punctuation
- Centred, right-aligned and justified paragraphs keep their alignment in Word
- Typing right after a paste no longer produces a squeezed paragraph
- Text pasted from Mail and Notes no longer locks in the hidden macOS system font
- Blank lines pasted from Mail and other macOS apps now behave like real blank lines
- Invisible characters from Outlook and similar mail apps no longer come along with a paste
- PDF export and Print render footnote citations in the note style
- Rejecting a tracked deletion that removed a footnote marker keeps the note's citation numbers current
- Import Reviewed DOCX now merges a reviewer's edits to footnotes that contain citations
- Arabic, Hebrew and Persian paragraphs keep their direction in Word and PDF
- Right-to-left direction stays consistent across the editor, PDF and Word, and never flips a contents entry
- Footnotes inside a Supplementary Materials text section export with their text
- Saving no longer overwrites a copy of the project that synced in from another computer
- Imported tables no longer lose their top row
- The Header checkbox works again on a table imported without one
- Table references no longer pile up when a manuscript is exported and read back in
- Reopening an exported thesis no longer stacks a dead table reference each time
- Reopening an exported thesis keeps it a thesis
- Reference titles with markup or entities render safely
- Word's Heading 7, 8 and 9 styles import as sections
